market.question: Bitcoin Up or Down on April 30?

assessment.reasoning: Resolves at 12:00 ET Apr 30 vs 12:00 ET Apr 29 BTCUSDT close. BTC was trading ~$77,500 mid-morning Apr 29 and dropped to ~$75,650 by 1:49 AM EDT Apr 30 — a ~2% slide. With price still drifting down and intraday momentum negative, a recovery above the Apr 29 noon close by Apr 30 noon ET is less than 50/50. Probability of UP (YES) ~30-40%.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Short-term reversals in BTC are common; an intraday bounce in the next several hours could flip resolution.
